reference.name: csem_reference
reference.basis: Zhou et al., TGRS 2026, DOI:10.1109/TGRS.2026.3661733, equations (12)-(13)
reference.status: LWD adaptation; not an exact reproduction of unpublished training details
assumptions: Original CompVis KL-f8 core, pretrained initialization, RGB-channel mean follow the reference method.
AlexNet ImageNet normalization, ReLU layers [1,4,7,9,11], and equal layer-MSE averaging are explicit design choices.
Pixel L2 is implemented as elementwise MSE; paper norm notation does not fix the code reduction. Loss coefficients are tied to these reductions.
feature_weight=1 and kl_weight=1e-5 are starting values, not recovered CSEM paper hyperparameters.
SGD lr=2e-4, momentum=0.9, weight_decay=5e-4 and 10 epochs borrow from the uploaded inverse-scattering launch setup.
EMA is disabled here because its use in the CSEM final experiment is unconfirmed.
48x120 input, batch4, float32 and validation-log10rho model selection are LWD implementation choices.

Dataset v2.2 uses a globally aligned y-z frame and a horizontal reference sequence with local anticlines and inclined fault offsets; isolated block/lens bodies are excluded. Tool inclination belongs to the forward model.
